scope: Launch entry points: Euler and wavelet/polyphase case studies, the elementary seed example, and the Paper I introduction. Not a whole-manuscript citation audit.
discovery: Existing Euler SOURCES and literature records

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, Chapter 4
sources.material_used: Secant-series Euler sign and factorial convention
sources.translation_and_limits: Positive secant values use the compressed even-degree index; formal coefficient calculations do not use an analytic error bound.

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, Chapter 24
sources.translation_and_limits: Signed full-index Euler numbers and Euler-polynomial variable are distinguished from the reciprocal-power parameter.

sources.title: OEIS A000364, entry credited to N. J. A. Sloane
sources.locator: Definition, OFFSET, AUTHOR; b-file indices 0 through 15
sources.translation_and_limits: Only the sequence identification and existing comparison prefix are used. No OEIS program is copied.

sources.title: OEIS A211212, entry by Peter Luschny
sources.material_used: Recurrence by Ilya Gutkovskiy (2020-01-27); cosine/cosh generating function by Michael Wallner (2020-11-17)
sources.translation_and_limits: The existing quartic denominator is matched after rescaling the formal variable. The asymptotic entry and third-party programs are not used.

sources.title: OEIS A181985, entry by Peter Luschny
sources.translation_and_limits: An ascent is required exactly at positions divisible by the block length. This identifies the pattern, rather than supplying a new enumeration proof.

sources.title: Wim Sweldens, The Lifting Scheme: A New Philosophy in Biorthogonal Wavelet Constructions (1995)
sources.version: Author-posted SPIE 2569 paper, pp. 68-79; exact PDF SHA-256 recorded
sources.locator: Figure 1 and forward/inverse algorithms, PDF p. 5
sources.material_used: Split/predict/update mechanism and reversal for reconstruction
sources.translation_and_limits: The project chooses a pair predictor and update, then rescales the detail. The source mechanism supports this specialization; no speed advantage is claimed.

sources.title: Paul Garrett, Abstract Algebra (June 2007)
sources.version: June 2007 author manuscript, text read through web PDF extraction; no retained PDF hash
sources.locator: Theorem 10.1.1, Corollary 10.4.1 and Example 10.4.3; printed pp. 126 and 130-131
sources.material_used: Polynomial-module cyclic decomposition for Paper I single-operator seed generation
sources.translation_and_limits: For a nonzero finite-dimensional space over a field, r nonconstant invariant factors give r generators. An irreducible divisor of the smallest factor divides every factor; quotienting by it gives an r-dimensional residue-field space, proving the lower bound. The zero space has count zero. This checks one classical input, not the wider framework.

sources.title: Martin Vetterli and Jelena Kovačević, Wavelets and Subband Coding (1995)
sources.version: Authors' corrected online manuscript; exact PDF SHA-256 recorded
sources.translation_and_limits: Half-sum normalization requires weighted synthesis energy. The finite circular FIR matrix is derived in the project with its own boundary convention; the book supplies the representation method, not that numerical example.
